findings.title: Mermaid file import is falsely advertised idempotent
findings.why_it_matters: Clients may automatically retry open_mermaid_file because the metadata promises that identical calls have no additional environmental effect. In reality, each successful retry creates another persisted BPMN file with a fresh UUID-backed filename, so retries silently accumulate duplicate diagrams and change the current context.
findings.suggested_fix: Classify open_mermaid_file as ADDITIVE (idempotentHint: false), update EXPECTED_ANNOTATIONS, and add a repeat-call probe asserting that identical calls currently create two distinct BPMN files.
evidence: src/server/tools.ts:593 assigns IDEMPOTENT_UPDATE, whose idempotentHint is true at lines 33-38.
src/server/handlers.ts:298-313 converts the source and calls importXml on every invocation; src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:931-932 assigns defaultFilename and persists the imported context.
src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:1430-1441 embeds a fresh IdGenerator.generateUuid() value in every default filename.
A focused runtime probe called open_mermaid_file twice with the same filename: both calls succeeded and the saved BPMN count grew from 1 to 2 with distinct filenames.
tests/contracts/tool-annotations.test.ts:51 repeats the incorrect tuple, while its idempotency probe at lines 152-171 covers only update_element and save.

testing_gaps: The behavioral idempotency test does not repeat open_mermaid_file, so the exhaustive metadata table and packed tools/list parity check can agree on the same incorrect semantic value.
